title: The B1G Show
description:
More Than a Coach
On his path to Olympic gold, Purdue diver David Boudia leaned on coach Adam Soldati to help him on the road to achieving his dream. Now, it's David's turn to help Adam as he navigates the biggest challenge of his life.

Ball State at Ohio State
The Ohio State Buckeyes host the Ball State Cardinals at Ohio Stadium for Week 1. Ohio State looks to build on a 12-2 playoff campaign from their last season, while visiting Ball State aims to bounce back following a 4-8 campaign.

Northern Illinois at Iowa
The Iowa Hawkeyes host the Northern Illinois Huskies at Kinnick Stadium for Week 1. The Huskies aim to recover following a 35-31 loss in its season finale, while Iowa looks to build momentum off a 34-27 ReliaQuest Bowl victory in the last season.
